title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.6 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 17:23 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 19:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 471 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)

Give Sunny a Like and Follow! 💛☀️💫

Today's Sun shows two visible sunspot groups and a broad, elongated dark coronal feature, with no obvious large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
